code:
-- SIMPLE recovery: log truncated automatically
--   no unbroken log chain -> STOPAT impossible

-- FULL recovery: log chain preserved
--   STOPAT works to any moment

-- BULK_LOGGED: works, except inside a
--   minimally-logged bulk operation
